title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2931 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 885 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I am a doctor in training. I often experience difficulty in doing my prayers on time and find that I may be risking my chances of succeeding in my program as I risk offending my supervisors who can make my life difficult. Is it ok to delay prayers beyond their proper time and make them up later to protect my standing and chances for success, so that inshallah (God-willing) I can secure a good career. What are the limits of compromising on our principles when faced with intimidation or a threat to our careers or goals in life? Question: I am a doctor in training. I often experience difficulty in doing my prayers on time and find that I may be risking my chances of succeeding in my program as I risk offending my supervisors who can make my life difficult. Is it ok to delay prayers beyond their proper time and make them up later to protect my standing and chances for success, so that inshallah (God-willing) I can secure a good career. What are the limits of compromising on our principles when faced with intimidation or a threat to our careers or goals in life? Answer ID: 885 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 811=770/B) If you can not pray any Salah in its time then make its Qaza (makeup) later. It is disliked to delay Salah to another time without any pressing situation. If you perform Salah regularly your problems also may be solved and you may succeed in your goals. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
